metadata.fit: CPU float64 conditional BCE + weight-sum L2; LBFGS; unweighted positive Platt

contract.selection: maximum calibration replay policy tokens/ms, including measured scalar CPU inference
contract.weighting: exact E17 train-only regret weights, normalized separately within each conditional depth
contract.calibration: independent unweighted positive-slope Platt, same as E17
contract.gate: E17-style fixed-control gate plus positive grouped gain lower bounds against matched F1 and E17 selected
limits: same E17 split and 20 test roots reused for a prespecified architecture comparison; not a fresh external test
only calibration selects between two fixed MLP candidates; no test-driven architecture, seed or hyperparameter tuning
same F1 features, frozen hidden projection, draft/target, greedy arithmetic and costs
scalar CPU inference is the timed deployment backend; no GPU model batch claim
offline replay rates are estimates, not measured online throughput
